rationale: Round 2, tip 0783a507. ALL FIVE of my round-1 asks are ADDRESSED, verified byte-level at the tip: next.go:600 (advancePhaseOnClaim epic warning) and release.go:189-192 (describeReleaseSyncFailure) now wrap through next.RenderBDError; complete.go:525 escapes lineageErr via termsafe.Escape exactly as its sibling :503 does; approve/spec.go:113 wraps the epic-create warning; lifecycle-modes.md's residual citation is function-anchored. The G3 sweep went further than asked (state.go, repair.go, scopeResolutionRefusal's chained errors, the completeSyncPhase and backfillExistingEpicPhase lock-path wraps, the emit-guidance/preflight sweep) and the net-new chokepoint hardening in renderBDError (force-quoting a stderr line that reads as a `recovery:` line) is correct and Unwrap-preserving; the new hostile-render family tests pass, and I confirmed the recovery-prefix check trims whitespace before matching. HOWEVER, re-running my round-1 method against the tip finds ONE coherent residual family the sweep missed — my round-1 ask explicitly included 'sweep for any remaining %v-rendered RunBD-derived errors outside the already-escaped surfaces', so this is a PARTIAL on that ask, not a new lens: bead.MergeMetadata's merge-READ leg (bdcli.go:331-333, GetMetadata -> tracedOutput -> wrapBDError) and bead.GetMetadata directly both carry wrapBDError'd raw bd stderr, and eight sinks in internal/complete render those chains raw (see concrete_changes_required). Same threat model, same one-line fix shape as everything already converted; a single wrap at the two package-local seam defaults converts the whole family at once. Everything else on my lens re-verified clean: G6's sExitContract change (fresh-classification sole authority, escaped entries) leaves my round-1 b5/b6 seam trace intact; the G1 attestation's own new render sinks are already escaped (materialize.go:129 uses RenderBDError) and its write-before-publish/mismatch-FOREIGN/read-failure-propagates shape raises no new seam on my named three. Empirics at 0783a507: go build + vet clean; internal/complete (347s) and internal/next (213s) -short PASS; cmd/mindspec targeted + the new hostile-render family tests PASS. My round-1 F3/F4 observations stand as recorded (no change demanded).
concrete_changes_required: Escape the bead-metadata error family in internal/complete — the one remaining wrapBDError-capable chain rendered raw at the tip. The chain: bead.MergeMetadata's merge-read leg ('bd metadata merge-read failed: %w' <- GetMetadata <- tracedOutput <- wrapBDError's raw stderr excerpt) and bead.GetMetadata directly. Raw sinks: internal/complete/complete.go:1100-1104 (reconcile-evidence guard.NewFailure, %v metaErr — the most prominent: a REFUSAL body, and in branch-reworked code); complete.go:1200, 1217, 1237, 1255 (the four override-metadata Warning prints); internal/complete/panel_advisory.go:872 and :883 (panel-audit metadata warnings); panel_advisory.go:537 (obligation-read refusal — returned upward and printed raw by cmd complete's 'error: %v'). The returned %w chains at panel_advisory.go:429/436/451 reach the same raw cmd print and belong to the same family. RECOMMENDED SHAPE: rather than eight per-sink wraps, wrap once at the package seam defaults — completeMergeMetadataFn = func wrapping bead.MergeMetadata with next.RenderBDError, and completeGetMetadataFn likewise (internal/complete already imports internal/next; RenderBDError preserves Unwrap so bead.IsUnsupportedFlagError and errors.As classification are unaffected) — converting every present and future sink in the package at once. Add one hostile-chain pin per the round-1 fix's own family-test pattern.

findings.title: Round-1 asks 1-5: ADDRESSED (verified at tip)
findings.detail: cmd/mindspec/next.go:600 wraps epicErr in next.RenderBDError; cmd/mindspec/release.go:189-192 wraps the SanctionedDerivedSync error (doc comment even names the symmetry with next.go's twin); internal/complete/complete.go:525 renders lineageErr via termsafe.Escape(lineageErr.Error()), byte-matching the :503 sibling convention; internal/approve/spec.go:113 wraps the epic-create warning; project-docs/user/guides/lifecycle-modes.md now anchors the completeSyncPhase residual by function name, not line numbers. The sweep also correctly wrapped backfillExistingEpicPhase's error before DescribeLockFailure (approve/spec.go:92-96) and completeSyncPhase's before DescribeLockFailure (complete.go:1349-1354), both Unwrap-preserving so the timeout classification inside DescribeLockFailure still works.

findings.title: Sweep ask: PARTIAL — the bead-metadata (GetMetadata/MergeMetadata) chain is still rendered raw at eight sinks in internal/complete
findings.detail: bead.GetMetadata ('bd show %s failed: %w' at bdcli.go:425) routes through tracedOutput -> wrapBDError, so its errors carry the same raw, unescaped bd stderr excerpt as every chain the fix round converted; bead.MergeMetadata inherits it via its merge-read leg (bdcli.go:331-333; the write leg uses tracedCombined, whose error text carries no stderr). internal/complete renders these chains raw at complete.go:1100-1104 (%v metaErr in the reconcile-evidence refusal), 1200/1217/1237/1255 (override warnings), panel_advisory.go:872/883 (audit warnings), and panel_advisory.go:537 (returned obligation-read refusal, printed raw by cmd/mindspec/complete.go's 'error: %v'); the returned chains at panel_advisory.go:429/436/451 are the same family. This falls under my round-1 concrete ask's closing sentence ('sweep for any remaining %v-rendered RunBD-derived errors outside the already-escaped surfaces'). Fix is mechanical and best done once at the completeMergeMetadataFn/completeGetMetadataFn seam defaults (see concrete_changes_required).

findings.title: Sibling class, pre-existing on main — note/file, not blocking: raw COMBINED-output folding in bead.Close and bead.DoltCommit
findings.detail: bead.Close (bdcli.go:166, 'bd close failed: %s' of raw combined output) and bead.DoltCommit (bdcli.go:193, same shape) fold unescaped bd combined output into error text that reaches cmd raw prints (e.g. 'closing bead: %w' -> RunE -> 'error: %v'). This is NOT the wrapBDError seam — the folding predates bead 9 and exists on main — so I am not counting it against this branch's fix round; it is the same threat class, though, and worth a filed follow-up so the escape boundary eventually covers the combined-output channel too (or wrapBDError-style handling is extended to tracedCombined).

findings.title: Round-1 seam basis re-verified after the fix commits: no regressions on my lens
findings.detail: (a) G6's sExitContract rework (fresh classification as sole authority, knownResidualArtifactDirt fallback dropped, per-entry termsafe, kebab WARN name) preserves the b5/b6 seam properties I verified round 1 — genuine dirt still refuses at both the pre-S and S-exit boundaries, and the indeterminate skip's structure (staging strictly before step-6 derivation, early return before step 6.5) is untouched. (b) The G1 attestation adds a bd metadata write inside materialization: write-before-publish means a crash window can orphan an attestation without a ref (harmless — the discriminator consults the attestation only when a marker ref is present), a stale attestation over a FOREIGN/absent marker is cleared or ignored, and attestation read failures propagate rather than defaulting; its own refusal render (materialize.go:129) is already escaped. No new interaction with the b2/b7 lock seam or the b7/b8 ordering. (c) The net-new renderBDError recovery-line quoting is judged sound from my side: per-line termsafe first, TrimSpace'd prefix match, strconv.Quote of the raw line (Quote itself escapes control bytes), Unwrap chain untouched. Empirics at tip: build+vet clean; internal/complete and internal/next -short PASS; cmd/mindspec targeted suites + the new hostile-render family tests PASS.
